oracle_basis: Sisay's WUBRG ability searches for a legendary permanent with mana value strictly less than Sisay's power.
If Sisay leaves after activation but before resolution, use Sisay's last-known battlefield existence to determine the search ceiling.
Removing another legendary permanent can lower current Sisay power only when it removes a color no remaining other legendary permanent contributes.
Tishana's Tidebinder can directly counter Sisay's nonmana activated ability.
invariants: removing Sisay never erases an already-stacked activation
last-known Sisay power is frozen when Sisay leaves
ceiling denial is reported as a downgrade unless the required mana-value threshold is actually crossed
shared colors are not double-counted in Sisay power
post-fetch Marvin/Ioreth, Derevi/Emiel, and Shang-Chi/Tyvar branches remain distinct interaction windows
fetching an engine piece is never automatically labeled a win
